List ad platform connections#

get/v1/ads-manager/{projectId}/meta/connections

Requires ads-manager.read. Lists the project connections without access tokens.

Parâmetros de caminho

projectIdstring (uuid)obrigatório
Exemplo
curl -X GET "https://api.trackup.me/v1/ads-manager/{projectId}/meta/connections" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY"
Respostas
200object

Successful response.

projectIdstringobrigatório
platformstringobrigatório

createdAtstringobrigatório

countnumberobrigatório

Update an ad entity budget#

patch/v1/ads-manager/{projectId}/entities/{entityId}/budget

Requires ads-manager.update. Updates the budget in Meta and the locally stored entity. Meta permission/session errors return 403.

Parâmetros de caminho

projectIdstring (uuid)obrigatório
entityIdstringobrigatório

Meta campaign or ad set identifier.

Corpo da requisição

entityTypestringobrigatório

Valores: campaign, adset

dailyBudgetnumber

In the ad account currency, major units (50 = 50.00). Send exactly one of dailyBudget or lifetimeBudget, matching the budget type the entity already uses.

lifetimeBudgetnumber

In the ad account currency, major units (500 = 500.00).

Exemplo
curl -X PATCH "https://api.trackup.me/v1/ads-manager/{projectId}/entities/{entityId}/budget" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "entityType": "campaign",
  "dailyBudget": 0,
  "lifetimeBudget": 0
}'
Respostas
200object

Successful response.

dailyBudgetnumberobrigatório
lifetimeBudgetnumberobrigatório

Malformed request or an invalid operation.

Get ad entity metrics#

get/v1/ads-manager/{projectId}/table

Requires ads-manager.read. accountIds, parentId and campaignIds use comma-separated strings. Selected accounts must share a currency. Synthetic query: accountIds=11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111,55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555&startDate=2026-06-01T00%3A00%3A00Z&endDate=2026-06-02T23%3A59%3A59Z. For ad sets, append &level=adset&parentId=campaign-example-1,campaign-example-2; campaignIds uses the same comma-separated format.

Parâmetros de caminho

projectIdstring (uuid)obrigatório

Parâmetros de consulta

accountIdsstringobrigatório

Comma-separated ids of the project linked ad accounts (the id from the linked ad accounts list, not the platform account id).

levelstring

Valores: campaign, adset, ad · Padrão: "campaign"

parentIdstring

Comma-separated ids of the level above, as returned in the table rows: campaign ids when level=adset, ad set ids when level=ad.

campaignIdsstring

Comma-separated campaign ids (from the table rows) to narrow adset or ad levels.

startDatestringobrigatório

YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar day in the team timezone.

endDatestringobrigatório

YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar day in the team timezone.

searchstring
statusstring

Valores: ACTIVE, PAUSED, ARCHIVED

Exemplo
curl -X GET "https://api.trackup.me/v1/ads-manager/{projectId}/table?accountIds=…&startDate=…&endDate=…" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY"
Respostas
200object

Successful response.

Get ads manager breakdown#

get/v1/ads-manager/{projectId}/breakdown

Requires ads-manager.read. accountIds is a comma-separated string. Selected accounts must share a currency; day buckets follow the team timezone. Synthetic query: accountIds=11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111,55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555&startDate=2026-06-01T00%3A00%3A00Z&endDate=2026-06-02T23%3A59%3A59Z. List connected Meta pages#

get/v1/ads-manager/{projectId}/meta/pages

Requires ads-manager.read. Lists the pages visible to the selected project connection and their fans, followers and engagement on the latest 25 posts. A failed Meta request for a page contributes zero metrics. Synthetic query: connectionId=44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444.

Parâmetros de caminho

projectIdstring (uuid)obrigatório

Parâmetros de consulta
